title: FairStrait Platforms
text:
FairStrait Platforms

notes_summary:
Mid-market product org evaluating Redwood Hosted API (initial) then moving to Dedicated. Pricing negotiation primarily about commit size, ramp schedule, burst pool, and overage caps. Security and data-residency are must-haves. CTO is price-sensitive but values predictable latency. Evaluation has moved from POC metrics to commercial terms.

poc_summary:
Hosted API used for 2 weeks to validate model fidelity (Claude-like open model). Dedicated pilot (10 days) demonstrated stable p50 latency 95ms and p95 270ms under synthetic peak. Observed KV cache hit-rate ~18% improving chat tail latency. Satisfied quality SLAs; cost model favors Dedicated at >1.2M tokens/mo.

pricing_expectations:
Customer expects a 12-month commit with a 3-month ramp (25%/50%/100%). Wants a dedicated burst pool equal to 20% of committed capacity with pre-negotiated overage rate not exceeding 1.5x standard unit price. Requests a soft cap alerting system and automatic throttling option as fallback. Seeking volume discounts at 1.5x, 3x, and 5x commit breakpoints. Redwood proposed a 10% discount at 1.5x, 18% at 3x, and 26% at 5x, with a 30-day notice window for ramp changes.

ctos_quote:
"We need predictability — can't accept open-ended overage at 3x price. If we can't get a bounded overage curve + a burst buffer, we'll have to revisit alternatives." — Marta Ruiz, CTO

negotiation_notes:
AE pushed a flexible ramp to reduce initial commit barrier. SE validated burst compatibility with autoscaling policy. Legal flagged two items: data residency clause and audit log retention. Customer requested SLA appendix for latency and a written example billing run for a burst event. Agreed to produce a sample 90-day ramp invoice and proposed overage cap language by next week.

next_step:
Finalize pricing term sheet; legal to review draft SOW; SE to validate burst plan

next_steps_detail:
1) Jordan to send updated commercial sheet with capped overage language (due 2026-03-14). 2) Priya to deliver burst failure mode playbook and sample billing scenario (due 2026-03-12). 3) Legal exchange: Redwood legal to receive FairStrait redlines to SOW (expected 2026-03-18).

blockers:
internal procurement signoff
data residency SLA language
clarity on burst overage rules

risk_assessment:
Medium: strong product fit and POC metrics but procurement/legal and final overage terms are gating. If overage unacceptable, probability of walking ~30%.

customer_constraints:
Requires SOC2 + SSO integration in 30 days, must keep EU customer PII in eu-west-1; contractual audit logging for 12 months.

timeline:
2026-02-28: Initial self-serve sign-up; api key issued; ran eval tests on hosted for chat and embeddings
2026-03-02: Fireflies meeting — 45m demo with Jordan + SE (Priya). Discussed Dedicated pilot. (ff_2026-03-02_8421)
2026-03-04: 10-day Dedicated pilot spun up (4xA100 equivalent) — workload: support-agent chat + embeddings for doc search
2026-03-07: SE runbook shared; latency targets captured (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for chat), throughput target 120 reqs/s during peak
2026-03-08: Cost analysis — baseline hosted projected $9k/mo @ current volume; Dedicated commit proposal discussed
2026-03-09: Pricing call with AE (Jordan), SE (Priya), CTO (Marta Ruiz) — discussed ramp and overage ceilings
2026-03-10: Redwood sent draft term sheet (v3) with 3-tier commit / burst options; FairStrait responded with counter on overage multiplier

communication_log:
03/02 call (ff_2026-03-02_8421) - demo; 03/09 pricing call - counterproposal sent; 03/10 email thread: Jordan -> fairstrait procurement (thread:1765b3f8c2)

internal_notes:
Try offering: 9-month ramp with lower entry commit + higher burst fee but capped at 1.5x for first 6 months. Consider adding an initial free burst credit (200k tokens) to demonstrate operational behavior. Track competitor pricing from ModelServeX — they undercut on entry price but lack prefix caching and debuggability.

final_notes:
Customer motivated to move to Dedicated if we can align on a predictable, bounded commercial model and provide explicit ramp + burst handling. Good upsell potential for Redwood Optimize after 6 months.
